_comment: Pterodactyl egg for Heather: keeps Discord bots online and sitting in voice channels
name: Heather
author: hrxshxx@users.noreply.github.com
description: Heather keeps many Discord bots online 24/7 and sitting in voice channels from one server, with an optional manager bot to move them around. Put your bot tokens in tokens.txt (one per line).
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull --ff-only || true; fi; if [[ -f package.json ]]; then npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund; fi; node index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Heather install script
apt-get update
apt-get install -y git ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [[ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]]; then
    echo "No git repo set, upload the Heather files yourself in the file manager."
else
    # Add credentials for private repos
    GIT_URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
    if [[ -n "${USERNAME}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]]; then
        GIT_URL="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}"
    fi

    if [[ -d .git ]]; then
        echo "Updating existing files"
        git pull --ff-only
    else
        # Clone next to any files already uploaded (like tokens.txt) and keep them
        rm -rf /tmp/heather
        git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_URL}" /tmp/heather
        cp -an /tmp/heather/. /mnt/server/
        rm -rf /tmp/heather
    fi
fi

if [[ -f package.json ]]; then
    npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
fi

if [[ ! -f tokens.txt && -f tokens.example.txt ]]; then
    cp tokens.example.txt tokens.txt
fi

echo "Install done. Put your bot tokens in tokens.txt and start the server."

variables.name: Manager Bot Token
variables.description: Token of the manager bot that controls the other bots with prefix commands and !panel. Leave empty to run without a manager.

variables.name: Manager Owner IDs
variables.description: Discord user IDs allowed to use the manager, comma-separated. If empty, any server admin can use it.

variables.name: Manager Prefix
variables.description: Command prefix for the manager bot.

variables.name: Default Voice Channel ID
variables.description: Voice channel for bots that don't have their own channel ID in tokens.txt. Leave empty to only keep them online.

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description: Repo to install Heather from. Leave empty to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: GitHub username, only needed for a private repo.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: GitHub personal access token (read access to the repo), only needed for a private repo.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest Heather from the git repo on every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Headless
variables.description: Run without the step-by-step setup, straight from tokens.txt and these variables.
